dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) API Catalogue entry
evidence_slice: GOV.UK API Catalogue entry for Historic England's National Heritage List for England (NHLE) states that NHLE is the official up-to-date register of nationally protected historic buildings and sites in England; it contains points and polygons for Listed Buildings, Building Preservation Notices and Certificates of Immunity, uses British National Grid (EPSG:27700), is updated daily, is licensed under the Open Government Licence, and publishes the Historic England National_Heritage_List_for_England_NHLE_v02_VIEW FeatureServer endpoint. The catalogue page itself is dataset/endpoint metadata and does not expose the Honeylands List Entry 1267530 record or its polygon coordinates.

field_evidence.footprint: The official catalogue confirms NHLE contains Listed Building polygons, but this metadata window exposes no Honeylands List Entry 1267530 polygon coordinates.
field_evidence.record_binding: No record-level Honeylands feature is present in the catalogue page; only the dataset/endpoint is identified.
field_evidence.type_use: Explicit Honeylands building identity/type-use evidence is already present in the verified lineage; this window was selected only to seek the missing official footprint geometry.
field_evidence.retrieval: The GOV.UK API Catalogue page was readable and confirmed the official endpoint, daily update cadence, EPSG:27700 spatial reference, polygon coverage and OGL licence.
